verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Lemon Squeezy offers an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The 'intelligent segments' that update automatically are rule-based email marketing, a different feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
